_note: documents-as-agenda-items — this finishes a sentence AgendaItemType has been carrying since configurable-types-domain-model, whose own description says it exists so that 'oral questions, interpellations, incoming documents, council information letters and kascommissie reports stop being five separate schemas with five top-level menu entries'. Three of the five are done. These are the other two, plus the technical question that only ever existed to hang off a letter. An incoming document and a letter from the executive are both something put before a body at a meeting, which is what AgendaItem models; the distinctive fields go in typeFields, which is what that property was added for.

IngekomenStuk.description: SUPERSEDED (documents-as-agenda-items): incoming correspondence is an AgendaItem whose type is a kind the organisation names, hung under the list item it was registered on. Its distinctive fields live in AgendaItem.typeFields. Definition and slug are kept (hardDelete:false, existing rows).

Raadsinformatiebrief.description: SUPERSEDED (documents-as-agenda-items): a letter from the executive to the body is an AgendaItem carrying a kind the organisation names. `subject` became the item's title and everything else moved to typeFields. Definition and slug are kept (hardDelete:false, existing rows).

TechnischeVraag.description: SUPERSEDED (documents-as-agenda-items): a technical question about a letter is a SUB-ITEM of that letter, which the agenda already models through parentItem. It never had an identity of its own: `rib` was required, so a question without a letter could not exist. Definition and slug are kept (hardDelete:false, existing rows).
